#!/bin/bash
# The second round of the simulation of the insert in two steps, its last
# pass at 10M (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "La puerta del
# insert en dos tiempos", the two amendments of 2026-11-28): the insert as it
# would run, in 10 waves, and the provisional edges that enter the lists of
# their neighbors by code. The scenarios are those of sim2.sh, which was
# stopped before this pass so that the measures of the base would not wait
# for it: it no longer decides the gate. Over a clone of the 10M index,
# removed at the end. The binary is built before (lock/holds.test); nothing
# here builds. The marker is up: the events count their CPU.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
W=$S/sim2
B=$S/lock/holds.test
P=$S/diag/src/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge
D10=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin
mkdir -p $W/10m-proto

printf 'the second round of the simulation, its last pass at 10M (sim2/sim2b.sh), since %s for about an hour and a half; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

mkdir -p /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim2b
cp -c -R /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/index /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim2b/index || exit 3
find /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim2b/index -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S 10M, 10m-proto (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $P && PE_DATASET=$D10 PE_DIR=/Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim2b/index PE_OUT=$W/10m-proto/result.json \
  PE_SIM="base,proto:10:16:a:64:0,protop:10:16:a:64:0,proto:10:16:a:128:64,provi:10:16,provi:25:16,protoi:10:16:a:64:0,protoip:10:16:a:64:0" \
  $B -test.run '^TestSimTwoStep$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $W/10m-proto/run.log 2>&1)
echo "10m-proto exit $?"
python3 -I -B $W/gate.py table 2.9 $W/10m-proto/result.json
find /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim2b -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done (idle $(hid_idle) s)" | tee $W/end-10m-proto.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
